isolation_statement: Reviewer read only sources-only.json, author-a.json, author-b.json and the resulting review file. No code, FAQ, tests, old reports, history, Jana calls or Jana outputs were accessed.
grading_notes: Accept semantic equivalents; do not require exact phrasing, sentence count, implementation detail, or UI behavior that the articles do not establish.
Documented absence of a feature is supported knowledge, not an unknown fact.
Unknown policies, contacts, schedules or personal values cannot be supplied by inference or invention.
Correct optional details may be present, but omission of details removed from approved_required_facts must not cause a failure.
All original prohibited_claims remain applicable. Clarification cases must not assume the missing object, actor or result; requests for real personal information are unnecessary.
An example such as deleting a cancelled calendar event is illustrative and does not require a particular UI command.
